text: The actual game itself is fun. LITERALLY everything else is awful. CONSTANT pop ups trying to get you to buy things.. and I mean constant... it takes so long to get between games due to all of the absolutely pointless pop-ups. I braved through it for a week or so but i just can't bear it anymore. If you don't care about being constantly bombarded with shops and bonuses then sure, fun game. Otherwise just avoid this mess of an app.

This game was kinda fun when I started. But I got past that "beginner" stage where the app is very friendly to use, and now there's 50 pop-ups before I can play a match or visit the gift centre. And these pop-ups are repetitive, you get them the whole time you have the app running, every day. Tired of clicking off the same screens, asking me to buy or participate in things. Each city, prices get higher and photocards become less. What's the point to pay more if I always get 1 or 0 photocards?

Enjoyable but hard to keep playing. I really do enjoy playing this bingo. It's fun, I've made some friends on here. My main issue is having to wait 6 hours for a few free credits a day. The amount of bingo credits you can purchase aren't worth it. Example: $7 for 210 credits, one game of 4 cards at level 28, is 48 credits! That's $7 for 4 rounds. To purchase any of the decent daubs, you need to purchase gems. Fourty five gems is $5. One triple daub, is 25 gems. So 5 dollars for 1 daub!

been playing for few years. they have Facebook page, where you could send your questions, problems etc. today ,I send a question in there, after finishing twice seasonal room, new kitchen just opened and I haven't got new items. asking what is wrong. they didn't post my post, saying they don't accept people saying it's rigged. never said anything like that. I'm done with this game.

Anyone downloading this game through PrimeOpinion and the like - be aware that the developer/affiliate will screw you out of a good portion of your points. I was owed 5402 points for completing 2 tasks. I completed them but somehow they didn't track when every other task was tracked successfully. I wouldn't recommend playing it just for fun either, it takes about a week to load and has incredibly annoying pop ups after every round.

It's definitely more geared toward pay to win. There are many bot players and that makes it impossible to get a bingo at times. This game used to be enjoyable, but not so much now. On top of the aforementioned, the amount of pop-ups for purchases and events has gotten way out of hand. It's one thing if it were 1 or 2, but 4 to 6 every time you enter the game, exit a round, switch to another? Clearly they think constant ads will push you to buy. No thanks.

Entertaining enough, but as you get further along, the odds are you get stuck waiting for forever to get the final pieces to finish a room, they just give you pieces you don't need over and over again. Add to that, the constant barrage of options to 'buy' stuff, which is super entertaining, means that I, for one, will be uninstalling this game and moving on to something that doesn't drive me batty - I want to relax and enjoy, and I don't feel that with this game anymore.

Really struggling with this game, started off well, but credit rewards arent great, give you about enough for one 4 card game each day, so unless you get 4 bingos in one game, the only way to keep going is to buy credits... The same with any mini games, tou have to buy extra dice etc. to progress well. i've had 2 maybe 3 single bingos in my last 15 or so rounds, just finding it frustrating. Not a game I will continue to play.

The game itself is enjoyable, lots of elements that keep it interesting, unfortunately over the last few months the game play has deteriorated. It's very evident that it's driven to make you purchase as much as you can, which is having the opposite effect on me, as someone who used to do inapp purchases regularly and the plus membership. I now no longer purchase for anything as the credits drain quickly and you don't get your money's worth. Bring back the % off playing rooms!

Labeling this game as "free-to-play" is incredibly misleading, as once you get to a certain level, you never win. It isn't based on luck at all, as I see the same people winning over and over, meanwhile I haven't won a single game in the last 20 games I've played, which means I physically can't progress. I had a chat with a few people in-game and they said the exact same thing. Do not call your app free-to-play if it's actually pay-to-win.

the game itself is great. what ruins it is the masses of pop up ads which is very annoying. also you need to give more credits. logging in for 3 days to play 1 game is ridiculous. I propose a new winning tile, maybe a crown or something that could signify a free round of what level you are currently playing inc 4 squares. Just a thought to get people playing more regularly

Way too few available bingos each game and wins are very rare. All the extra stuff just makes everything way too busy and complicated. No ads but you get constantly bombarded to spend money. All I want to do is play bingo, not cook recipes or smash statues and I want to win occasionally. No card album so I can't help other players or complete it myself. Support is useless, can't contact them in game or via website, it just loops back and forth. Bingo Voyage and Bingo Frenzy do it much better.

The start is fun and it's possible to play. After a certain level you are looking at waiting for days to play one game, the rewards do not match the investment and the game becomes forgettable. Other games match the gains and bring more to bring you back, this game needs to up the rewards and fails.

Love the game but having to close about 10 pop ups about spending money before you can even get a game started is ridiculous and even if you don't press anything after about a minute or so MORE pop ups about buying things..... Edited Feb 2026, constantly getting pop ups about spending money and they've made it harder than ever to get items this game used to be fun, not so much anymore

I'm pretty sure calling this a "free game" is false advertisement. Sure, you're not obligated to make any purchases, but you can't win unless you do because you're matched against people who purchase power ups. I literally just lost 3 games in a row when the first bingos were called after 4 and 5 balls. And unless I purchase credits, I can't play anymore. It's a scam 100%. At the very least, if you want to be an app with any integrity, make separate rooms for paying and non paying players.

I'm honestly kinda surprised this game has such a high rating. It would be so much fun, but each round costs so much you can only do a few per day or you have to spend money. I've been stuck trying to get one card for days, and it hasn't even come up yet. I've seen people in the chat say they've been stuck on one card for weeks. The game goes noticeably more in your favor right after you spend real money on it.

Oof. You lose waaaayyy more than you win, and it's a game of chance, so really not much you can do to increase your chances of winning. Also, no particular way to advance. At one point, I played for over an hour, won 5 whole times, and still didn't receive any of the pictures necessary to advance. The game just arbitrarily decides. It's mostly continuous frustration as you watch your coin bank dwindle to nothing on day 1. The pittance they gave on day 2 was gone in 3 plays. I do not recommend.

Fun and addicting! Love it(: the only thing I don't like is the garden because you hardly use any of those ingredients for the dishes and it's hard to get the ingredients to finish the dishes anyways. Either take the garden out or make it so that you can grow more ingredients to finish the dish. I also feel like they have added a bunch more pop ups to purchase stuff. When I open the game I have to exit out of at least 5 or 6 of them, it's ridiculous.

Fun game but the amount of pop up menus is genuinely ridiculous. Every time you finish a game or go into a different screen you have to sit through 4 or 5 different pop up menus begging you to buy something. I tried starting a game before the menus could pop up and they popped up IN THE MIDDLE OF THE GAME. Genuinely pathetic if I don't want to spend money stop begging for it.

No ads always makes a game better and this one has none! Fun gameplay, great graphics, and rewarding! Some of the animation that can't be skipped is kind of annoying and takes a long time though. It's also been crashing lately. Once it was during a bingo game so I emailed the developers and they sent me back those wasted credits, but it's still a nuisance when a game crashes, hense the dropped star.

Really love this app, but do wish they had more choices of monthly subscriptions plans. For instance the one they offer now is $14.99/Mo which I feel is very high for what you get. I feel with that price you should get free coins for as long as you are a member. I feel they should also offer a not so expensive option that more people could afford maybe for $6.99 or $7.99 /Mo. I feel this price is much more reasonable especially with the cost of everything skyrocketing.

The game doesn't allow for you to play off your winnings. The prizes aren't enough to continue playing they want me to buy and the price to buy is outrageous. So while the game is Free to play there are quests that require purchase just to complete them and when you do win your winnings aren't enough to continue playing for free. So no matter how you look at it this game cost $$ to play

Definitely turned into a pay to play. And worst part is what you pay for will hardly get you any rounds to play. $1.99 currently gives you 35 blitz coins. It takes over 24 blitz coins to play an average bottom of the line round. You basically have to pay real money for every round, and the rewards system is basically barren. Paying over 100 blitz coins to win back maybe 10, and that's WITH their $15/month subscription!!! It's terrible and clearly only cares about money.. I'm unsubscribing..

the game itself is fine, but it's really frustrating to not be able to listen to my music while I play. It always stops every other sound, even though I turned off the speaking voice. also, in the first levels it's fine to play while you don't have any money, but in the later levels if you don't have money you're going to be waiting quite a while and it's very frustrating as well. the graphics are cute, the story in and of itself is cute, I'm giving it a 3 out of 5.

It's okay, constantly tries to get you to spend money of course, but the joke's on them, I don't have any money to spend 😂 there aren't many players at the early stages, so it's hard to progress, I get maybe one bingo every few days? But I'm a super casual player, I played a bunch years ago so it's not a big deal to me these days if it's slow, it gets me Fetch points.

It's a great free bingo game, you have the choice to buy credits if you run out of free ones but as you don't win money you would need to be very silly to do this. Annoyingly there are multiple spam pop ups that waste time when you load the game that you have to physically close to continue, but there are no ads. A nice distraction.

Best bingo! But I also started spinning at (funxspin,соm💎) and it's been pretty wild lately hit $9300😎 yesterday and cashout was surprisingly fast. And for the Bingo Blitz: it's fun to play, the bonus games keep you entertained, and the interface is easy to navigate. The only downside is that as you progress through the higher levels, you have to bet higher. That's okay, but you win a quarter if what you would at the lower levels. Unless you want to spend real money on in-game purchases every.

This game is fun to play, hence 2 stars instead of 1. However, it's heavily designed to entice people to pay money, & then MORE money for credits and other perks as progress resumes, but it's STILL difficult to win cards, puzzle pieces, etc. just to advance to the next round. I play everyday, throughout the day & I've been stuck in the same area for the past couple of weeks (or more), waiting >1 week to win the last card. How other people advance faster than others is beyond me.

Thanks for reminding me why I deleted the game years ago! You spend more credits than what you win, they make it impossible to win the cards you need to finish games/challenges! I guess you have to spend money to get anywhere in this game! And don't forget the pop-ups, one right after the other to buy power-ups! Not worth playing unless you like to spend money!

honestly, super sad. I really loved this game but I got stuck behind the paywall. sure it's luck and chance, but after 2 week of 0 wins and unable to really recoup any tokens to play, I'm stuck having to buy or just not play. this was my favorite bingo game, even got the subscription. but I'm not going to pay 24+ dollars to get tokens. eventually you get to a high enough level and you'll find plenty of active, high level players who are stuck.

Fun- but it is kinda pay to play/ win. The more you spend the better your luck of winning. And you run through chips fast, especially as you progress. And now they've come up with cards you have to earn to get through the city's and special cards that are not able to be traded and only able to be got by the game and it takes sometimes weeks to get them (read a month or longer) to progress. It's frustrating. But it has other mini games etc to play and it is still entertaining

You will end up having to pay to even play after a small amount of time. They'll give you 10 credits here and there but minimum to play where it's even worth a $*** is 60 credits minimum. Who wants to save up free credits for one round where they'll give you barely any daubs and your lucky to get a bingo. The games has become TOO RIGGED where users have to buy alot to enjoy. Don't get trapped.

"Based on luck and chance" when literally there's bingos after two numbers called. It gets to a point where you can't progress without paying or waiting for daily rewards and hopefully getting enough bits to play a round. It was fun until then. The pop-ups are also really annoying, wish there was a way to opt out of them.

so many pop ups at the beginning of the game and is soo pay to win. I also hate that you can't use coins to buy power ups, you either have to buy or wait a while for one. I had such high hopes but now I've spent several hundred dollars on this game and now I'm wondering if it was all worth it. I know you need some pop ups but like 1 or 2, BUT 6!!!!! please fix this fast

The game used to be fun, once you reach higher level it takes weeks or months and 1000s of credits to complete one room to receive 1400 credits. I play that in one day! I have spent lots of money on this game even for the subscription which I have now canceled because the game is not even fun anymore causes stress I don't need. Rather go back to bingo bash

which moron thought making 90% of the stuff you need to interact with ( buying cards, marking numbers etc) require phone breaking levels of pressure was a good idea? have to hit the screen like 10 plus times and it still doesn't register, barely hold your finger over the store or interact with the notification bar (on the phone, not the game) and it opens straight away though, absolute scum practice dude, not ok.

only has in game ads which is nice and they can be closed quick. when you first start playing it's cool, rewards are great but as time goes on you only get enough chips everyday to play (if your lucky) 2 games. the price to play 1 game with 4 cards is unfair considering how many daily chips you get. it's almost impossible to get the moxie ingredients. the prices are not really fair either. to pay 9.99for 180tokens or whatever it is. cheaper cost per game and more daily tokens would be great

can go days, sometimes even weeks, without seeing a red tab (new pic needed). it is an addicting game, but to be able to play more than once a day, you will need to spend money. really loosing the fun of it. yes, there is a daily tournament, free of credits to play, but it in no way helps you to advance in the regular play rooms. and although you do offer free credits on your social media pages, once you get in game they say already received-which is wrong. you will need to spend money

This game is so fun but so difficult to play. there is an insane amount of pop-ups every time you enter the game, finish a round, come out of an event, etc. It makes the game so incredibly frustrating! The rounds cost so many tokens but you barely get any in the dailies. Unfortunately this review will mean nothing as their replies to other reviews show that they don't plan on improving the parts of the game that frustrate their players. What terrible customer service!

The ads are out of control! buy buy buy!! there's nothing exciting going on, just buy! stuck in rooms for weeks, even months. the amount of credits per card is ridiculous. I've played since 2011. I quit playing for 5 years. Thought, hey maybe its gotten better. no, its gotten worse. I have since quit playing again. Sad, because I used to love this game.

Update: Time for me to say no more with this app. It was fun when it started but after I made the stupid mistake to spend money it became the only way to complete collections. After the update in 2025 it was terrible until April 2026 then the game did another change at first it was good ($) but with the Golden Card it is terrible. Also if you do not purchase directly from them you get less. They say it's luck but it is money. If you are going to play do not spend money and xgl to you if you do!

graphics is awesome. price is crazy. and the pop-ups;brutal. 3 to 5 ad just to play one round. technical issues; you get to go round and round with tech support till they actually understand the situation. so many people complaining how creators GREEDY. not to mention the freebie mongers. " out of credits can someone gift 4 5 6 when 1 2 3 are freebies. wow Monopoly is better platform as doesn't charge arm n leg and tech support is way faster

edit to repsonse: be so for real, 99% of the pop ups are trash offers to buy lol. nice try. The pop ups are horrible. Getting one after every game end you have to click through 20 pop ups to close trying to get you to buy some horrible deal, lol. Also, "luck" based but after the first few beginner games, you barely get to touch your card even if you buy 4. Crazy.

this game has gotten so annoying with, I guess, developers' greed for VIRTUAL credits. sitting on one single location for MONTHS getting 2 credits in a chest not getting ANYTHING useful. it was great literally a couple months ago, when the chests were useful and had a lot of credits in them, which meant you really could play normally and finish a location that needs 12-16 cards in just a couple hours. the fact that it isn't what it was back then is extremely unappealing for any player. do better

Starting with, not a fan. the game play, visuals, and music are pretty neat. Nothing that can't be found other places but, they put in work. That being said, having played A LOT of bingo through the past year, this one is a scam. it is REALLY hard to advance without paying money. The cost of cards and all the little pushes to get you to pay more for your buy in is just way too high. Even after spending over $200 of my money (in about 30 days), the game seems designed to drain you, forcing $

If you really really like pop ups this is the game for you! It's awful!! 7 pop-ups or more before you can even play first round, then also every time you play a round! Seriously?!! You also now get to watch an ad for extra stuff! It has become like all the other games with pop-ups This used to be a fantastic game that's why I've been playing for years but all it's become is a money grabber and the sad part is people actually spend money and BB becomes greedier!

Too many pop-ups at start up, one of which appears twice in a row. I've logged in multiple times today for the free gift but the number of balls hasn't changed, so I can't play. What's the point in earning coins? Why does it take so many balls to play vs the amount you earn back? This used to be a fun, cute game but that's changed. The makers seem to be focused on reminding people to make a purchase. News flash: not only am I not wasting money, I'm also uninstalling this waste of time game.

Pass time. My star rating will stay where it is for now. It might decrease, at some point. Rewards need to be improved. And so far, I haven't found where these coins are going or what to use them for. I can't buy power ups or bingo credits with them. I absolutely refuse to spend my hard earned money on a game, so I have to wait for a measly daily reward and a few credits from gifts, just to play this thing.

Addictive game! During the first day of game play... After that you'll not play it anymore unless you spend real money on it because your energy will take forever to recharge (12 in 12 hours when you need at least 40 just to play one level...) and the rewards are ridiculously scarce. There's not even the chance to watch adds for energy. Not worth. Uninstalled. Thank you, go get your money somewhere else or make it more worth it. This is ridiculous.

You get very little credits daily to play. There are different locations to master. Each consecutive location costs more credits to play. You can stay in the lesser locations to play cheaply. But if you want to advance without spending real money, you have to save your daily credits for almost a week to play one game and lose. None of the special events or promotions help either. No thanks. It could be such a fun game. But it really just feels like a cash grab. Uninstalled.

The game used to be so fun, but now you rarely win anything. You're spending all your credits every day cause the cards cost a fortune. Daily credits and the few free credits you can get are so low that it gets you nowhere unless you don't play a few days to build your credits back up. Even with the monthly subscription, it gets you nowhere, so it's even worse if you're not paying at all. I'll be removing the game to hopefully find something better. Hopefully, they will make the game fun again.

In my opinion, Bingo Blitz is slowly going down hill. With the coins you win, you should be able to buy things with them like credits, power-ups, ingredients or even diamonds. Instead they can only be used in the slots. I win coins, but never use them, because I don't play the slots. When you win any credits, you win very few now. Also, there are too many pop-ups. They are annoying.

I have been a BB plus holder for almost the whole time I've been playing. I love playing this game until I got to the island I am on, the first city on this island I have spent over 8,000 coins and have been in this city for 2 weeks maybe more. I am stuck like many others getting the gold cards. I have 530+ wilds but I cannot use them. The game won't let me. Support can't understand they say it's by chance it's not . Don't waste ur money on this game u will be stuck too. Lots of pop ups not fun!

I purchased the Plus Membership for $15/month thinking it would allow me to play more. In fact, once the algorithm realizes you will pay to play, the outcomes are worse. It makes it to where you constantly feel like you have to purchase something to make the daily goals so you can earn credits. I don't recommend this game and have canceled the Plus Membership. These developers are way too greedy. After seeing the developer's response I see that they don't care about our experience. Good luck.

I love bingo games, but this one is certainly not it. You eventually build yourself up to get 4 boards & still can't get a win. Way too many pop ups to try to make you buy, which I would never do for this game. The payback in tokens you get if you're lucky enough to win isn't even enough to play another game. I usually only have enough for 1 game per day. I get games need to be challenging, but when you win about 5 games in a month span, it's not very enjoyable.

Incessant popups to pay for things or play prize games (often with a video) disrupt the game that you're currently playing, and have to use coins for, making it time out and causing you to lose the game and coins. The annoying little cat that pops up to announce the winners also pauses the touch access making it so you have to tap the ball 4 or 5 times until it marks the space, which will start blinking at you as if you missed it 🫠 Other than that, it's ok at best.

Three times now I have spun the wheel for the daily calendar of prizes daily. 2 times landed on 500 extra credits & 1 time on 700 extra energy credits. Each time it moved after stopping to the one next to it. Sent in 8 emails to support and no reply concerning the 1700 in energy credit that was won. Also no purple gems being counted and given to me since game was downloaded in slot after each game but can see them going in consistently. Also cost to play in energy credits changes constantly !!!!

Only thing i diskike is you can no longer use coins to buy power-ups. You should change that back. 5/11/26 edit- another thing.. WHY do many ads to buy buy buy. i had to hit the " x " like 10-12 times before i could even get into my "server" . its really annoying and honestly turns me away from even wanting to play 😒 its excessive. I'm not saying don't have the ads, obviously yall need to make your funds too.. but jeez, all at once? talk about overwhelming.

Way too many popup ads for purchases. Additionally once you get level 20+, the number of bingos per players drastically drops which ultimately heavily reduces playability as rewards become much less. So you can't play much at all unless you feel like spending $5 per session/game. Edit: In response to dev comment... your response is totally bogus and you know it. It is to try to squeeze out every cent you can. You couldn't care less about player enjoyment. Please don't lie to me.

scam alert!!!!!! Do not play this game, oh it cheats hardcore. I've been stuck on the same level for a week. they won't give new stickers. I'm basically stuck on the same level with no hope in sight. If you're being gangstalked then don't play this game. It's a shame what they are doing. Also, this game has multiple layers of possible employees or developers playing the game also so you can never win especially if you spend money. It sucks. you can't even play for fun.

Canceled my Bingo plus subscription, I was an idiot to keep paying for a service that doesn't help the game play. Even with the plus, you can't complete any side games or many dishes in the kitchen. People have to spend a lot of money to really play this game!This game has become a joke since Playtika has taken over. It's just about the money now and not the customers. My reply to their response is I did pay monthly, collected everything possible, and still wasn't able to complete the games.

Very annoying with having to click through at least 6 to 7 pop ups before you can even begin play. You also have to click through even more pop ups (to make purchases) in between games. If you don't make purchases, you can remain in one room for months and may win once in a great while. Unfortunately, It can be very frustrating instead of fun.

The game itself is fine but please stop with the 15 pop ups the moment I open the app. The offer train seems to have no end and I have either wait to skip things or I spend like 5 mins closing the pop ups and looking for the x to do so. Please find a way to make this optional with a trigger of if someone wants to look at the offers, they can instead of what the default currently is. It's annoying and mars the entire experience.

ITS THE DISRESPECT FOR ME!! It's an everyday frustration even opening the game! Now, on top of the lack of progressive abilities, there's a pop up saying I need to confirm my age in my Google account. I have. Infact, every Gmail attached to this phone was age verified. However, my account wasn't linked through my email, it's through facebook. so, help me understand.. what do I do whenever the support option on this pop up notification, takes me to a bb help page only to say "NO RESULTS FOUND"!

spent $550 on this game this month (June) on 2 accounts (2 phones) and have been stuck on level 5 (the last level) trying to win untradables. They rarely appear and when they do I cannot win on the card it's on. I practically stopped getting bingos double daubs, and the side games are stuck in neutral. I don't do returns when I complete a room I win them again then I'm a hostage after I win tradables. Started out great then I spent $ and now I have to pay to advance . WOULDNT RECOMMEND IT.

I'm no longer enjoy this game like I use to. Completing cities and rooms is not easy or cheap! Waiting to receive the last item to move on in the game, is ridiculous and makes no sense. You will be waiting and wasting your time trying to advance... multiple bingos and receiving multiple duplicates... too many in game pop-ups for purchases as soon as you open the app... 5 to 6! Being a pluser isn't worth it anymore.

I'm only leaving 3 stars. I do love this game HOWEVER BB You guys have wayyyyy too many things pop up soon as you log in, and quite frankly it's ridiculous. All of the things that pop up can be found in the play store on the app itself. I absolutely hate logging in, and have to constantly keep hitting the "X" to close out the offers. one or two is fine but 6-8 back to back to back is ridiculous... BB, y'all can do much better Other than that I absolutely love it

The latest update has made getting bingos impossible. The in game lagging and decreased probablility of a bingo have caused me to update my origional 5 star rating. I had over 20,000 coins prior to the latest update and now can't win a base island classic game to get enough credits to do anything else. Very disappointing because the game was very fun prior to this insane update.

no good way to gain credits. cannot play for more than 10 minutes at a time. WAY too many pop-ups for in game purchases. need to close up to 7 before doing anything. you can ear credits by cooking things in the cooking side game but earn nothing on the slots side game. not impressed. do not believe the 4.7 rating is accurate. majority of reviews were 3 stars or less. don't waste any money on this game!

I would give 5 stars but the app robs you of bingo wins, OFTEN. it'll be the last ball called (that gives you a win), but the app automatically cuts the game off, not allowing you to even dab the square to achieve the win. that's extremely frustrating given the fact that you, (me in this case), purchases an offer to continue playing- frequently at that, and it ends up being a complete waste of money.

the game is fun at first, it has you win a lot in the beginning to get you to stick with the game, but after awhile it becomes a money grab. They will sit here and tell you its all luck and chance to win but that doesn't make sense seeing as you start off winning a lot then suddenly almost never get a single bingo. they dont even give you enough daily credits to play the game even if you get the rewards from their social media. When they say paying only helps you progress is a lie. Don't install

You think we're stupid, but we know there's some silly algorithm that intentionally doesn't pull the numbers that we need. THIS GAME IS A WASTE OF TIME AND MONEY!!! DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!!!!! UPDATE: So once you've stopped playing for a while they'll reward you with anywhere between 500 to over 1000 credits for a while, then it'll stop and you lose credits, you lose bingos and then THAT'S WHEN THEY WANT YOU TO PAY AND SPEND MONEY. AGAIN. SCAM SCAM SCAM. We play more if we win more. DUH

The game is very frustrating due to what I'm told is BOTS controlling the bingo games, cheating them, causing the rest of the games to skip from 7 (sometimes 10) to directly 1, every single game. The second extremely frustrating feature is the insane amount of Pop-up Ads that are very dominating of the game, one directly after the other!! The ads completely block the player from playing until you click the x in the corner to close it AND they're difficult to close!!!I do not recommend this game!

😡0 stars, I hate that I recently reinstalled it. I used to LOVE IT. now it constantly freezes lags crashes, disconnects. repetitive tech support help needed being forced into ridiculous events. impossible to get what you need to complete. I play 5 different accounts, one has the &14.99+ tax/mo plus subscription still can't win. TOO MUCH GOING ON bonus games, cannons, tournaments, gold card, kitchen garden rascal. I'm so disappointed. after my subscription ends I'll delete it once and for all.

every event every week no matter what I always come up short. I never complete whether it's just a roll of the dice on the mini side games that bingo blitz has , or not having enough points to finish the challenges. it's very frustrating because I spent all of my extra money on this game and it is such a waste of money . tired of getting g ripped off every single day by bingo blitz. it's obviously run by ai and they make it really hard and it's a complete waste of money. they are greedy
