It was fun to begin with, but now it's just boring because I'm not paying to play. The rewards are not random at all, they are given to keep you playing for a while. But after a while, it will stop giving rewards in hopes you'll pay.

UPDATE!!!! Just uninstalled this game. Complete ripoff. wants you buy everything and can't get out of this rooms for nothing. UPDATE!!!! I been playing this game for years and lately you can't win anything! you'll be stuck in a room for months, I've spent money on this game, subscribed and everything. I should've kept my money. Even being subscribed doesn't do anything better. It's a complete ripoff.
I love This gamem because it is so much fun. I cannot wait to get new bingo balls every morning

Lame....no bingos after how many games. when you finally do bingo, it doesn't even cover the half the 'cost' of playing another round. Just a big push to pay actual money to play the game where you don't get any actual money back. Disappointing.
I downloaded this game from FreeCash, I don't normally play games on my phone but I genuinely enjoy this one!

Hysterical that I get a response - 6 YEARS later!!!! Obviously the game has changed quite a bit. Still stingy with the daily credits. When I said the games are not cheap, I meant using credits! Only get enough to play two or three rounds each day, pitiful after all these years that that has not increased. I still play obviously and love the game, just have to go weeks in between playing so I can let my credits build up and make it worth playing. 2/12/2016 - This is my favorite bingo game! I'm addicted to it. Unfortunately, a little stingy with daily credits and the games are not cheap. Problems lately with collecting gifts and free spins from others plays etc. Fix these issues and the game will be perfect.

I love this game, really do. I just feel like the amount of time played, how long it takes to get Bingos, pass levels and get ingredients for dishes before it finishes .... then we should be compensated more with more credits. I also don't seem to be the only one who feels this way. You don't give enough. I'd love to play more than 1 round a day. I'll come back and edit the review if it improves.

I have had pretty much played for two years and I use to love it! It is very addicting but I am ready to uninstall! I have been stuck needing one item (clock) for a year now in dubai and I use to buy credits but that is just non sense... you buy power ups and rarely get instant in which I had 99+ at one time and somehow they disappeared ...fed up with the non trading items..it takes to long to finish rooms... then let us win a ton of the non trades for what? So we can sit there and look at them?

Great game concept, very fun. Economy of credits ruins the game though. Playing four boards, you can hit 3 out of 4 bingos in a round and still lose money. Which makes no sense. Early on, there are lots of extra bonuses to keep you going. Once you get past the lower levels, those stop and you just run out of credits unless you spend real money. Ruined what could be a great game.

I started playing a couple months ago, but won't be for much longer. There's no passive recharge of credits, and you have to x out of way too many ads just to play. Getting bingo is nearly impossible (and useless) because they'll eventually give the pieces you need in chests. I liked it for a while to pass idle time, but a recent update has made the quests WAY harder than they used to be. I used to get decent rewards out of the first levels, but that stopped. It's just not fun anymore.

Compared to every other bingo game that I've tried, this is by far the most fun, interactive, and challenging one of all. It used to be nearly perfect. Now, there's way too much going on and the goals they set for you are impossible to reach. I save credits for almost a week straight and then can only play a few rounds before they steal all my credits back and nothing to show for winnings. The cost to earning/winning ratio is SO off balance & unfair that we can't even progress/help our own team!

Fun bingo game but needs some improvements. Why when you change the food challenge, we can't keep all the food we have left to go to the new challenge. The daub's are getting redicualis. I mean how many times a day do you need them. You give us a 72 hour run, then a 1 hour and a 3 hour all in the same time. I have been playing for a long time. But it just makes it frustrating for some people. Here's to 2020 may we try to make improve.

When i first started playing it was great. A lot of fun. Now? It just pisses me off. You almost never get to win. You start getting in the game and run out of credits immediately. There is no option to "watch publicity" to get a couple more credits... Noo, it asks you to pay to get them. And the prices are very high for the amount of credits you get!! 2€ for 100 credits? That's 2 games!! The more leveled up you are, the worse it gets. Honestly, what a shame.

Great game play without ads! I do love the inside game collections and rewards throught the levels. This is an awesome feature. I do wish we could claim the bingos we have at the end. Unfortunately there's not a few seconds at the end of the game to do so. My friends list is a bit confusing if I'm not connected to FB. I wish it would allow me to choose my friends

The bingo games, quests & side games are fun. I've been a player for almost 10 years, but recently felt the need to edit my review from 5 stars to 3. The game has become too expensive to enjoy. Each game "costs" so many bingo credits, I usually can't play more than a couple of games without making an actual purchase for more bingo credits. Wins are nearly impossible & rewards for winning are nominal in comparison. I uninstalled this game twice before & am going to uninstall it permanently.

Been playing this game for years and still play it every now and then. It's possible to get to a very high level without spending a single dollar, but it will take time. The higher you are the more you have to spend in credits to play. Daily caps out around 90 credits, and that's with getting the collectibles which hard very hard to come by. Best to play with a FB group that will help each other out or you will be out of luck.

Game is fun but frustrating. There are non tradeable items in most cities that are next to impossible to win. They either never show up or the odds of a bingo are astronomically against you. I've spent thousands of credits trying to get one untradeable item in three cities before giving up and moving on. Problem is, that counts against you in certain achievements. In Cape Town, I went from 8900 credits to under 2000 credits in a week, including the daily gifts of credits.

I used to love this game, and would have given it 5 stars at one point. But it's more irritating than anything now. When the facebook page posts links for free gifts, they don't work, EVER. The cards are way too expensive. 15 credits a card is a little ridiculous. And it's hard to get credits other than spending actual cash on them, and even then, it's expensive and you barely get any, 80 credits for $10, that's crazy. I'm sorry, but the more popular Bingo Blitz gets, the worse it is.

love the game!! at least the concept of it, they just make it hard to play without buying this or buying that, and you have to if you want to finish the room, or finish cooking ...... the graphics are great, the stories are good but rooms are really to expensive to enjoy, and the items to collect in order to complete a room shouldnt be so hard to get. needs more regular rooms in my opinion. but all in all i love the game !

This game used to be fun when I started a few years ago. However, now it's worse than ever and I can see why lots of people have left. For the past 2 months the bingo numbers constantly freeze up when playing. We have to hit the number 2-3 times before it actually shows up on the bingo cards, the same goes for boosts being used. Game is running way to slow, it's a freaking nightmare!! Instead of the developers being so money hungry, worry about fixing the game for the enjoyment of everyone!!

I loved it for the first month. Even bought some good deals. Then the app updated and I can't get simple ingredients for side game, free credits aren't working, daily spins are giving only power ups instead of credits (and you get those every 2 hours anyways), teams can't finish their boards, and the list goes on. I get making money off an app but seems it should be advertised as a paid game and not free. 2 more days to see if they fix glitches or I'm out.

They overload you with credits and special event items when you first join, to the point where a lot goes to waste! Once you've made some progress, and they feel they've got you hooked, everything stops. You'll be lucky if you can play 2 rounds a day and the game constantly tries to get you to buy stuff. They also discriminate among players, one person will be charged $2 for credits/boosts while another will be charged $9 for the EXACT same pack. It's extremely disappointing.

It's a pretty good game when it works. It freezes though right in the middle of the game. It loses the wifi connection often. I gave it a 1 because they seem to have fixed the commercials interference inside an actual game being played. Fix it to work correctly on wifi like my other games and I will change my rating. If it continues, I will delete it. Currently, it's unplayable. I lost my timed rewards because it keeps losing the connection. Thx 🙃

I just had the option to update or delete and I really actually had to think about it. Lately, many players are very unhappy with the changes that's been going on. Myself included. It's not fun anymore..and its nothing like the commercials..if it is ,it's only because you've waited over a month or longer trying to collect 1 item to advance. It's a tiring tedious task. Used to be my 'go-to game' but I found another game that I prefer and can play all day..not just once a day. Done and 😫 tired

The best part of the game is the daily tournament. It is actually free. Get to play 5 rounds at no cost. Otherwise have to use credits to play rooms & they cost more as you progress. Hard to complete rooms. Support says it's random but it doesn't feel that way. Some players have to collect 12 items and others only have to collect 9. Not sure how that happens. Plus subscription isn't worth the cost. Usually just play the daily free games and slots.

I play everyday to collect my credits. Everyday this game freezes. It won't credit shadow card wins, open chests, or give power ups. I'm uninstalling because it keeps freezing & taking my credits. Too many problems & no way to get my credits refunded & prizes credited. Too bad, I used to love this game. Thank you for the response to my review. It has been 7 years since I posted my original review....I'm not interested in the game anymore

The game has really improved! It used to be almost impossible to play more than 1 round. It's been a surprising & fun change! My only complaint is the Golden Spin. Every single time I've purchased them I never get more than 30 credits. I know the spin random & you risk that chance when you buy it; it's like carnival games & I don't mind wasting $1 here & there for fun. But, like carnival games, there's only so many losses & "almosts" before a person starts to feel a little suspicious & cheated.

I have tried on many different occasions to make a purchase to the ELITE membership. Different days and different times. But I keep getting the same responses. "Sorry for....the problem has been reported. This has been going on now for over 2 mo. I have also tried different types of pymts. I am about to delete and fine another game to play. One that rewards better. But I haven't yet b/c I'm to close to the next level. PROBLEM NEEDS FIXED, AND I NEED TO BE COMPACATED FOR MY INCONVIENCE

So fun at first!! So easy to level up. Lots of interesting areas, not just bingo. cooking, sharing, slots are super boring at one speed only. Edit: After playing for a few months, Ive noticed it is SO difficult to get non requestable items, and shadow cards which are not tradeable as well. in lvl 90s now, not fun at all. people request ingredients I can barely keep up with earning for my own progress. 1 star given. Don't waste your time or money on this one.

It's a fun game, hence the stars. But man, it went from 0 to 100 in how hard it got. It was casual and fun to play at first. Then it went to needing ridiculous amounts of points for finishing side quests. You get barely enough credits for winning to even play again. And the freezing up, they make sure to take your credits for the game played, but don't give you the winnings you got before it froze. I'm probably going to delete it as I like to play to chill out, not be more frustrated.

I have been playing Bingo Blitz since it first came out!! Very fun. One thing I don't like is the ungiftable items. I get stuck in every room needing an ungiftable item. Part of the fun is trading and helping other players. I will get a duplicate of untradeable items but can't send to another player. The game would be much more fun without the untradeable items!! The game has become very frustrating and the only way to advance is to purchase bingo credits. I gave up playing because I am stuck

This game is, at best, a temporary solution to boredom. It's only bingo. Also, the games model is heavily geared towards the devs monetary profit (and as a business it makes sense, no matter how greedy they are) Im just like everyone else, it'd be nice to level up or advance a little more often than once every other month. Kudos devs, for simply coding a classic well-established game and slapping your cat, colors and price tag on it while passing it off as your own. Bastards.

It plays a little too fast for me but I love the new team option ☺️ and that you can invite people from your friends list to join in. It's a great way to get to know people and help each other out ! I however do not like the new way of getting bonus gifts 👎. Sorry, but it's been poorly done 😔. Had it not been for that I would give this app 5+ stars.

Love this game. Been playing for years and you don't need FB to play. Update Nov. 2022, recent game changes have made it very hard to enjoy without buying into plus membership. Have to save daily free credits for a while if you want to play for more than a minute, or purchase credits.. team bonus is no longer achievable.. was a great game for a long time, but free players will find it frustrating now.

Overall a really fun game, but you have to save credits in order to play "boosted games" to get the more rare items for certain events. It can be frustrating to not get to fully enjoy the game just because you aren't an elite member. It's a real fun game for simple bingo, and it feels like you always have something to work towards, not just mindless bingo. I would recommend.

I love the game but as many have stated already you never get anywhere. And if we were to buy credits your outrageous. We need more daily credits to play to move on thru the game. Crashing not much an issue but the times I have in the middle of a game, no refund. Kinda messed up. To bring to conclusion if we could play more you'd received 5 stars. But still one of 2 my favorites

Credits need to be easier to win and at the very least cheaper to purchase. You run out of Credits way to quickly, then you stop playing and find something else. This would have a flow on effect, I wouldn't be recommending it to my friends, I wouldn't be as enthusiastic about playing anymore and I definitely wouldn't purchase a small amount of Credits for the crazy amount requested. It is a great game... if you have the Credits to play enjoyably.

UPDATE: Shocker, still one star. Game will not get past loading screen. It will load for a bit then come up with an error saying Connection Lost, There was a problem connecting to the servers. I've never had this problem before until updating the game (and Meghan Trainor became a spokesperson 🙄). I've uninstalled and reinstalled, I've changed locations and wifi, I've tried data, I've updated, nothing works and it's been a week since I've been able to play. Love having an app that doesn't work!

I'm beyond aggravated with this game. I've been playing this for years, and every time I turn around, they've switched things up. woke Saturday morning to find I've been logged out and can't gain access to my game. I've even uninstalled and reinstalled only to find it started me all over like a first-time player. room one, level one, game one. Not to mention all the credits, coins, and everything else that's just gone.

Its a fun game, its just that with how little credits you get from winning and other things. It makes it to where i can only play a few games every couple days. I play, then i have to wait and save up more credits. If you could make it to where you can get credits easier. I would happily change my rating to 5 stars. Other than the credits, its a great game. Really helps me when i need to do something to pass time by.

The game starts out great. Graphics are good and it's fun! I did not figure out power ups and I can't find info on them. Are they selected at random? Do you have to select before every game? What is the "new" tab for on the side of the cards? Can't find anything on that either. Once you get so far the game loses it's appeal completely. Absolutely no way to advance without having to spend real money. Even after buying credits they go really fast and with very little reward. NOT WORTH IT!

This game used to be absolutely amazing! It was hands down my absolute favorite game to play. I would play for hours sometimes, but they made some changes about 2 months ago maybe a little less then 2 months. I'm not sure, but my point is that ever since they made changes this game has gone downhill. They used to award you enough credits to keep playing but since the changes they have completely stopped helping out. Unless you have $$ to spend don't download this game. They are money hungry now

This game has become more difficult to win than the lottery. I will NOT be renewing my plus membership. The special rooms are near impossible to get beyond the first and second levels unless you spend a month's pay. Regular rooms leave players stuck for months. I don't see the value. Most nights, I'm lucky to get enough credits for 1 round towards my daily quests. I'm done. Then there's the bonus wheel, hardly any credits, and useless power-ups. Which players can collect every couple of hours.

This game grabs you in because it's fun initially! Then it becomes clear that you can't progress without paying, which is EXPENSIVE, with little in return. You can be stuck and not able to play for 2 weeks. The daily rewards aren't enough, and the special ingredients are nearly impossible to get, rendering the cooking portion nearly useless as well. You can hardly use the "tickets" anywhere. And no, I don't want to log into FB with it either (why?). Not fun if you can't play! Deleting. Sad.

I have Been playing since 2011. Over the years there have been many changes. Some are good, some are not so good. It is becoming harder and harder to finish a room. Under no circumstances should it take weeks to win 1 piece that is ungiftable!!! This game is NOT relaxing or enjoyable anymore 😞. I spent way to much money just to finish a room I had been working on for over a month 😐 I sure do hope you change the algorithm before I find a new bingo app to enjoy🤞, because I love this one!!

It can be fun. I like a lot of things about this game. Three things I don't like. It's difficult to get credits. The coins aren't good for anything except playing slots, which I don't like. If would be okay if the slot games payed you in credits, energy, and basket items. I also never have time to daub the last number shown before they lock up the game. I've lost a lot of Bingo's because of that.

Like the games but keeps taking away points. Like every day. Example. The other day I had 318 credits. I could play 2 games at 150 credits each. I played first one...should of had 168 credits. Went to play next game but I only had 108 credits. Wth bingo blitz. I have probably lost nearly 2000 credits so I don't get to it nearly as much any more. P.s. I'm a 10 year player. Almost since beginning.

I love bingo, but this app is a little ridiculous. The amount of daily credits is pathetic as you get into the higher levels. If you want decent rewards for playing, you have to save your credits up for 5-6 days before you play. 3-4 pop ups asking you to spend money to get more credits or tokens any time you change pages. If you choose to spend money, it ends up only giving you 15-30 credits ever (not enough for even a single card round). I'm pretty close to deleting for good.

After playing for over 10 years, and enduring many changes, I am stepping away from this game. I paid the subscription for access to more credits and options, but even then, it takes way too long to progress now. I used to look forward to my bingo break, but now, I pay $15 a month and I might play 2-3 games a day. They have cards you have to collect to move on, and some are nearly impossible to obtain in certain rooms, leaving you frustrated and playing the same game over and over for weeks.

I love playing this game, but there are continual pop-ups even when you have not accepted one, it keeps repeating along with the others. Its a frustrating expirence. It is very, very hard to get difficult items. I Have waited weeks, sometimes moths to be able to finish a task. It can also be a very expensive game. 30 daily credits is a joke when you are at higher levels that cost 15 credits per card, per game. Not everyone can afford to purchase credits.

Interesting that 95% of the comments are negative & yet they all have the same answer that it's based on luck, which I don't buy. You can clearly see the game has gone downhill over the years from a fun game to a $$$ grabber. Count me in as disappointed, it's near impossible to complete rooms or get shadow cards as the odds of winning & the credits given are totally misaligned. The only way you could possibly improve the game would be to use the coins to buy credits. Looking for another game.

This is a fun game to play. The big bonus is it has no ads, which makes it more enjoyable. You get to interact and help others along the way. The one negative, and reason I gave it 4 stars, is the further you go, the harder it is to get the untradable cards. It has taken me days to get one card. Others have mentioned they've been trying for 1 cars for weeks. That makes the game tedious and frustrating. Edit to add - They want me to rate it higher when some cards are impossible to get.

I have literally been playing this game since 2007 -ish. It used to be really fun and I could play for an hour or more with no issues. But now they've turned into every other gaming platform and you have to spend actual money to get anywhere or do anything. The daily quests are set up to where there's no possible way you could ever complete anything without spending money. 150 credits for four cards to get daily quests, yet you only get 120 credits a day... Make it make sense?

It has become increasingly difficult to complete rooms, stages, menu/pantry items. It's not as fun to play before the many changes throughout the years. Free credits have not increased ( excluding YouTube). Slow number calls. Yet it's entertaining at times., 😜 I must include, when faced with an issue the support team is great in assisting and resolving the matter.

Irritated!!!! As the levels get further along it becomes harder and harder to receive Shadow cards, you get the same cards over and over, it's almost like the game wants you to spend your own money but at the same time you still won't receive the cards that are necessary, it is becoming more difficult to get the ingredients that are required to cook your food. I am to the point where I am almost ready to uninstall this game!

I know the game is free to play..I see this is the automatic answer to criticism/displeasure w/ newest version. I've played for a quite sometime & I echo the overall downward spirl from it's beginning. It tends to happen to every game, begins it's great, then more ppl play the more opportunistic it is. Don't give me your 'purchase doesn't increase your chances of winning ' 🙄 of course it does. It gives you more credits, extra wheel etc..
Do not update. Since I updated on another device it constantly crashes. These issues and the new look have absolutely ruined the game. the screen keeps blacking out since pac man was added.

I had originally given 5 stars in my first review, but I have lowered it to 3. I have been playing this game for many months now. The shadow cards are nearly impossible to get at the point I'm at and the amount of daily credits that I have to play with daily is very limited. However credits are impossible to get, other than your daily allotment, just as much as the shadow cards. It's really getting to where I'm not enjoying playing the game anymore. Very disappointing.

I used to love this game but it's just not fun anymore. You only get enough daily credits for one game unless you win and even then you may not win enough to play again. You can win room collections for credits but some of the items are non giftable making it too difficult. In one room I have 57 duplicate items but I'm still missing an ungiftable. There are only 12 different items in the room and I have 57 extras!!! Ridiculous. played since 2013. Uninstalled for a new bingo game today.

It's okay... You're not going to get very far if you don't play four cards at once, and the more cards you play at once, the more it is... They want you to spend $4.99 for a package that includes two power boosts, a picnic basket and 100 credits. On my level (88) playing 1 round of bingo with 2 cards with a Super Pack is 52 credits. It's just not worth it. There needs to be more ways to EARN credits, and I still have no idea what the COINS are for. You can buy more if you want to, though...

Great game, beautiful graphics. Unfortunately it's really become pay-to-play. To play in any of the theme rooms, it's a bare minimum of 60 credits for 4 cards. Daily credits allow for only 1-2 games, so about 10 mins of play. This was my favorite bingo game for years, but there are others out there now with comparable graphics and provide more free play time.

Could be a good game however only receiving enough free tokens to play only one game a day for weeks or months on end, or when you have completed a level get rewards and cant get get through the next level knowing you'll be here for another few weeks even months at higher levels at a game a day. A fun game that you can't complete without spending money. Edit..game freezes, takes away tokens you get free. Really disappointed. Deleted.

Money trap. Plain and simple. I loved playing it at first because the earlier levels were fair but the higher you progress, the harder it is to win and to complete sets. Daily credits are a joke and when purchasing credits it is clear that this app is trying to take as much money from you as they can. Example: $100 gets you about 2300 credits. If you wanted to play 4 cards you would use over 500 credits. So for your $100 you can play about 5 rounds. 5 rounds! Rip-off.

It's so unfair. I used cannon to get the last piece that i need, #11, for Level 3, Tie the Knot. The game froze, but when I tried to exit, it told me that I would lose items that I won (or something to that effect) if I would exit the game, so I patiently waited. When the items that I won finally show up, #11 is not one of them. I reported this incident and received 72 credits instead. Just wow. I never complained about my other issues, but this is just too much.

Used to love this game. I started playing again recently & was enjoying it. Then, it started freezing, saying no wifi connection, and just shutting down in the middle of a game. I was playing majestic level which costs 1500 credits per round for 4 cards. They did not give me back the credits I lost during their tech issues,it only gave me powerups some of the time. Lost over 10k of credits! Now, even with the daily credits, I can't build my credits back up, They just want me to buy more. Nope.

Crashed for absolutely no reason and now wouldn't load at all. The game is not like it used to be. Bingos are so rare in any room and I've been stuck in a few rooms for months!!! I think more importance is given to unnecessary graphics and animations. Frequently crashes everytime I'm close to winning, making me lose all my credits with no refunds. Disappointed

If you're like me and refuse to spend real world money in this game, you'll be a little frustrated because the daily bonus is only enough for one game with a few credits left over. The side games don't last long enough to finish them if you're only playing one or two bingo games per day, and you lose whatever stuff you had collected when the side game ends. Update: shortly after my original review, I discovered the daily tournament, which allows you tp play 5 games for free.

Love the game. Interesting enough, however, it's terribly hard to complete some rooms with the ungiftables. Especially the amount of credits needed to finally complete. One can play for months trying to get ungiftables. 1 ungiftable rather than 2 each room, or none, in some rooms would be helpful. Discouraging to have to play for months to complete. Dole out more credits, please!!

Have been playing for roughly a week, at first it was going really well and really enjoyable. The credits seemed plenty enough to play without paying. I decided a couple of days ago to buy a small package to support the game and ever since it's like a switch flipped, I cannot go longer than an hour before hitting a losing streak and losing all credits either forcing you to pay for more credits or end play until the next free credit drop the next day. Not worth your time.

Got hooked back to playing this app after years of absence. It has changed so much since then. I enjoyed playing then and still do. Things I enjoy: bigger rewards in special rooms, make dishes to gain more credits, and connecting more with your friends within the app. Downfalls: hard to get blitzy ingredients even with most purchases, as an elite member not having a better deal on purchases, having to pay more for things in general, annoying popups for specials -> should be in store only.

The game is entertaining but the credit system should be reviewed. The credits rewards are very poor compared to each card value, especially after the cooking event was taken out. If you can only play for 15 minutes everyday it's not fun. This game just wants to suck out your money. The credits are way too expansive and if don't pay it comes to a point you can't really play.

Love this game & have been playing it for years. But I've noticed that over the years, this game has become way too expensive to the point where you can't even play it anymore. The prizes have got less & less. The bingo credits have got less & less for more money. It's extremely sad that you barely get nothing for your buck anymore & it's even more sad to have been a dedicated player for many years to now feeling ripped off. Bring back the old Bingo Blitz that we all fell in love with.

It's a fun game, having said that, i have contacted them three times about not receiving wins towards completing levels. The first two complaints were never addressed and recieved no feedback. The third compliant i receieved a standard form letter as a response. Even after all that i gave them the benefit of doubt and played some more. The game still has ongoing issues as the issues remains the same. I would recommend a different game if you don't want to waist your time

Many players (myself included) have suggested getting rid of un-giftable cards, more daily credits, also when you do things like the cooking quests it's more than time to stop putting a receiving timer on your players. Thank you for your time. And yet none of this has happened. This game has gone downhill fast. It feels more like a "pay to win " than a game of chance.

I love this game. There are games inside the game to help you increase the Bingo coins that allow you too play more. I especially like the dice games. However, the slot machines are a waste of time. They are not that much fun, and the payouts are little. I usually end up losing my bingo money In a short amount of time. However, I don't have too buy anything to contine playing, I just have too play more bingo to earn more bingo money and the ads are almost nonexistence !!!!!

Changed my review from 5 stars to 2 stars. Getting plus was no different than having a regular account. Canceled that. It is literally taking me weeks to a month to pass a room, and the credits that are given aren't even enough to do anything. I have to wait several days to let daily credits build up just to be able to play a couple of games. This game used to be fun. I also wish they would let you use your coins to get credits to play bingo when you run out.

Had to come back and give this game the 1 star it deserves. It is skewered towards bilking you out of your money, which is a great business model. Playtika is a business, not a charity but they are greedy and could re-work the algorithms to balance out the game better for when you do pay. But they tell the lie 'it's all luck' and spending money helps you 'progress faster'. They sell 665 credits for $25, which is about 900 credits shy of playing one round at the highest level. And that's a sale.

Has gotten very expensive to play, changed alot of things which benefit them. It seems like they do not appreciate players. I play other games and you can progress right along, without spending money. A pack of credits a yr ago, maybe $29.99 and now it's $79.99. You can stay in 1 room for months and can't win anything. Very, very disappointed.

UPDATED:: too much going on in the game besides just bingo. The challenges ....there are too many and it is too hard to complete all of them without paying. Once you hit a certain level, it gets MUCH harder to pass the levels because the game seems to hold back the very thing you need. The game was updated in January and I lost all the pantry & garden items without warning. I had to start from scratch. :X Daily payouts reduced this week too. 😠

It is a fun game... however, I've constantly watched players get 1st, 2nd and even 3rd place bingos all in one round only to see myself struggle just to get close to a bingo. There's days I play for hours and only get one or 2 bingos. Seriously losing interest at a fast pace. Not to mention, the amount of effort it takes to earn bingo coins to play is overly difficult. I know the designers want to make money, but a little more reward for the effort of playing your game will keep people around.

The game has gotten harder and nearly impossible because of the 'untradeable' items that never come up to play for. Also I had free collection pass and was saving to see what I needed to use on. But when I went gift something I had five of, since the button to 'use collection pass' is right next to 'gift item' I accidentally hit 'use pass' and now it's gone. You really need to have a 'are you sure you want to use this?' popup. That's a rip off and I'm officially done unless I get it back.

I am really disappointed. I've been playing a lot recently. And all of a sudden, Chests in the game barely contain ANY coins or bonuses. This isn't a freaking Casino. Stop being greedy. I used to be able to spend $10 and play for an hour. Now, it all disappears in 1 or 2 rounds. I just find it really bad business. I'd be willing to continue being a paying player if you weren't making it impossible to move forward anymore. I am also canceling my monthly Bonus membership. This is ridiculous.

I have played this game since it came out years ago. I used to love it!! Now it has gone WAY downhill. The developers have become greedy. You should not have to spend 4-5 months and thousands on top of thousands of bingo chips in one room waiting on 1 item to complete the room. It was never like this before. Its all about buying high amounts of bingo chips. The slots used to be fun. You would have to get 12 items to finish the room. If you got 5 in a row or got the item in a bonus it counted. NOW its only on the rare chance you get a bonus and then get the item in the spin. They have made the odds worse than Vegas. Its sad for a game that used to be so fun.

I've been playing off and on for over 10 years. I like the game but it feels like all's they care about it money. There's so many pop-ups for buying everything. I've spent money and they give you very little in return. You would think it was a real money game for the prices they charge. $1.99 for 2 spins, you get 150 or so free credits a day and there's rounds that cost 2500 credits to play, which to buy would be about $50 in real money for 1 round. Makes no sense. Might as well play real bingo.

The game has definitely improved.With that said, they still need to hurry the completion parts of the games so as to not interupt the following round so often. but it's much improved! Kinda dislike having to participate in the addon cooking,2 game still has issues, I don't play it as often as I used too. I hate it when it freezes up and then runs through the numbers to fast. seems they're not giving as many money numbers on the free games as they used to. Can't finish levels as easily as before.

While this game is fun and addictive, it gets to the point where it is very hard to get bingos which furthers you in the game. Each level requires more coins than prior levels and those can cost $$. The real life cost to get enough coins to play mid-level bingo cards is quite ridiculous, actually. Beware, it is quite fun, one of the best, in my opinion but it will eventually cost you to continue playing and succeeding in the game.

Easily one of the worst things I've played. The power ups do not make the game more interesting, it's filled to the brim with micro transactions and begging for your money every other second. They're employing some of the worst tactics to do so too. including placing a transaction prompt where you would tap to continue into a new game, deploying "extra bingo" prompts if you lose and not clearly showing what power ups you have. if I didn't play this for rewards on another app, I wouldn't have.

Like all games, this one has pros and cons. Pro: Fun game and always has something going on. Daily coins on FB group. Cons: Credits go too quick. The purchase packages are crazy expensive with barely any items. Some worlds have black out cards you have to win in game, can't be traded. I've been stuck in the same world for several weeks. They claim it's based on luck, but 4 rounds in a row where I got 3 other cards but not the one I needed is highly frustrating and making me hate this game.

In the beginning it's fun but as you progress there are collection items that you must earn. Those particular items can take weeks/months to get. Yes, the game is free to play but the novelty wears off when you can see any progress. The game just begs for you to spend money. Kinda takes the "free" out of it. The game becomes less and less fun.

I will admit that I got sucked in by the cute graphics and fun mini game type things, but as I get further on in levels, I've noticed that it's less and less likely that I will get a "bingo"... And even when I do, I only get back the number of credits that I spent on the card. I could sit and play this for hours, but certainly don't see the value in purchasing credits to play. I am not a gambling type of person and get bored pretty quickly when there are constant offers to spend money.

Exhausting. This game was fun 10 years ago. It was fun 4 years ago. After changing hands, the game has gotten painfully predictable and obviously rigged. Rooms are fixed so there are a limited number of players and consequentially bingos, collection items are withheld to maximize the probability of you buying credits to obtain them, powerups aren't randomly distributed by a long shot. Having to see 17 popups begging for your money makes it worse. Save your time and energy & play something else.

I started playing this game for free, and won lots of bingos. However, once I became a "paying Elite" member, it costs me 3 times more to win the items to complete a room. The instant win daubs Almost Never Happens, as well as some of the power ups, to name a few. I live on a small income, yet this game just wants more and more of it, with less and less return. I have lost many games as I'm not able to utilize my power ups, and as another person pointed I out, and losing bingos.

I actually love playing this game, but the further you get they make it IMPOSSIBLE to get the pictures you need to collect to get to the next round. I've spent all my coins and spent multiple days before on just the CHANCE to win the picture I needed to advance. Also, you can spend 130 credits to win 2 pictures instead of 1 but a lot of time it will be the same picture on both cards. Like I paid more credits too get different pictures not the same one twice!!! It's absolutely ridiculous. #SCAM

Great game and way to pass the time, even connect with friends. It has many different sub-games to keep you interested aside from just bingo alone. The only thing I don't like is the credit system. Once you run out of credits there is no way to play the game for a little while. You are gifted 5 credits from friends every 3 hours, and that's assuming you have enough friends to collect them. So you have to wait 15 hours to get 25 credits to play ONE game on the lowest setting of 24 credits. Shame

I have a love / hate feeling towards this game. It's free in theory, but to go farther and not be stuck in a map room forever, you need to spend $$ . When you're not stuck forever, it's fun - that's why I still play. Plus I met the best team mates. We're sort of a BBTherapy or BBAddicts group. But we're in it together. They're the reason I gave this 4 stars. Game is good when it's good, just be warned - it can be super frustrating, time consuming & costly if you allow it.

When you first play it is great, as usual with freemium games. I just got a notification to check out what is new. Cost per game went up and it set my gamble thing to max automatically and didn't save where I previously had it set (like it did before). The prices for the chips are outrageous. Surprised by the rating people give it. I am not playing anymore because it takes days to save up to play one round and I am not spending 5 dollars to play 2 rounds of bingo. They need to change the pricing

Fun but inevitably a scam. This game is beautifully put-together with lots of games and mini games, but you use up your tokens so fast and then you're stuck either paying an obscene amount of money for credits or waiting for so long for credits to re-stock themselves that you forget the game even exists - I did that. I actually forgot about it for about two years. Within two days, I am no longer able to play because of the credits situation. Deleting the game.

Fun to play and very addictive. I like that, unlike many mobile games, you can still play and progress in the game without spending real money. (That actually makes me more likely to buy something as a way to support them). There's also more to it than just bingo - slots, a cooking game, bonus games (such as board games and scratch off cards) to keep it interesting and to get credits.

As much as I have been playing Bingo Blitz for the past seven years, I have not been able to comment, like, or participate in any of the events posted on Facebook. I have tried to comment and direct message them through Twitter and Instagram as well as through a secondary account, but I never have received any response on how to fix it or if I did something wrong to cause it. It's quite frustrating. Other than that, I'm addicted to the game and hopefully someday will get that red crystal.

There's a lot to say here, but I'll just summarize a bit. First of all, you set unrealizeble quests!!! The credits you give daily are a joke!!! Never enough to play more than 1,2 rounds. If only I could hit the bingo,but guss what? It's not happening! Also,the ingredients are repetitive and useless,without the few ones(that you never get to see).I am very very curious if anyone ever got to finish the whole menu,without paying real money to play.This is not all,but I will stop here.Disapointing

This would be the best game ever if they gave you credits ever! It cost 40 credits to play one new level. That's without boosting. If you boost your cards to get better rewards we are talking over 100 credits. I'm almost on level 80 and only get 35 a day. So tell me how we can even play or enjoy the game? You should advertise that if you don't have money then don't play this game you won't be able to enjoy it unless you level up which happens very slow after a certain level. You rarely ever get credits when you do a daily spin either. So if you have money to blow on a bingo game this games is awesome. If you don't then I wouldn't download it.

I absolutely love playing this game! Unfortunately,the coins to play go so fast that sometimes you hardly get any plays in. I wish there was the option to accept coins immediately from your friends who sent them to you. Instead,you have to wait a certain period of time to accept them unless you purchase your own for the game. In my opinion,the little games/challenges would be easier to try to complete (without having to spend money or wait a long period of time) if that option was available.

Been playing for years... See a lot of changes.. Some are awesome like being able to get goodies every hour and the teams. I am glad they added that feature cause it gives you a chance to meet people all around the world. Oh yeah the chat feature and trading cards is a plus. I only wish that they would take away the time thing. It is sometimes hard to get bingos and than to give a time thing (you would know if you play) is not cool. But overall I love the game!!! 😊

Too frustrating to be called a game of fun. You zip along in the beginning only to end up in impossible rooms to complete. You constantly just give back credits so painfully earned that most players have to depend on gifted items to play while they have no credits at all. Only to wind up needing just one ungiftable item that can virtually take 6 month to get. Tell me why in hundreds of games of bingo a single number does not pop up in 6 months time. Rigged? Players say yes. NIX UNGIFTABLES.

Subscribed to plus, not much perks to it at all. Daily free credits are not much. Pretty sad situation. I also cannot find how to cancel my plus subscription. Been a player since 2011 and to me, its not much fun anymore. Have to pay for more credits to play to to finish rooms. It is very hard to finish rooms. Hard to get pantry items also. Quests are hard to complete when it says you have to have your cards in super or above and you only get enough daily credits to play classic. No fun to play.

I did enjoy it in the beginning. But each level you need so many more credits to play that your winnings don't come close to. It sucks that I can only play a few games a day and then I'm out of credits. Nearly impossible to get ahead in this game so you could enjoy it. For got those recipe challenges!! You can't afford to buy the baskets you really need. They want you to spend your money and you will if you ever want to get ahead. Too bad.

Greatest bingo ever! I had this on my computer way back in 2011, with a facebook profile specific for games. Had to shut that profile down. So glad they had this for mobile. I downloaded it, and it plays the same as many years ago. I do have to say - that piggy bank is really annoying. I just want to play a game, and not have to have a "buy this" type of thing constantly being shoved in my face. If I want to pay, I will click the piggy and pay. That's the only negative.

While this is definitely a great game, I wish more credits were available. While there are ways to earn them, it is often hard to do so because you need the credits to earn the credits. Once you establish yourself into the game I suppose it gets better if you ignore the missions/challenges and play just the regular boards. It makes it hard not to play for days just to save credits because the game is addictive and fun. Outside of the credit issue, I have no other qualms.

Bingo Blitz is fun to play most of the time but lately it's frustrating and you've made it impossible to get past the higher levels. No use complaining, that won't change, I just don't make purchases anymore. My immediate complaint is about the emails you send with "gifts" that you can't claim. I don't know what kind of time is given to claim but it definitely seems like less than 24 hours! Just one MORE reason to find another game! Clear cache doesn't work uninstall is the next step.

Been playing for 8 years. Always enjoyed. Now it's super hard to make progress, super expensive, and players are very unhappy and complain constantly. I'm shopping for another bingo game. The sad thing is the reviews are all the same from us long time players...and the response is the same nonsense response. You guys have to do better than that. Cut the ads, lower the prices and make it easier to achieve the cards. Respond directly to that.

Fun game. But it certainly feels like a "freemium" mind funk sometimes. They have certainly figured out how to keep people coming back every day and to play as long as possible. Sometimes credits last a while sometimes only a few games. It takes a while to get the hang of the card trading between other users and chats are mostly positive with sprinkles of some players complaining about other players asking for cards.

As a player of many years, don't download! The "free" game has become nothing but a money pit and truly isn't worth the hassle. You'll get stuck trying to get ungiftables for months and can't advance. Players are becoming more and more rude as the stress from not getting anywhere builds up. $100 for 6 rounds. The more you spend the more expensive it gets for less. Just don't waste your time. Developers don't care, trust me, we've all tried reaching out. Save your sanity.

This game is a lot of fun. That being said, dont download this unless you have a lot of extra money to throw around on a game. It's extremely hard to get anywhere in the game using the daily tokens or the packs that cost a minimal amount. There's also not much reward given to people who spend a LOT of money. I bought pack for $259, the tokens didn't even last long enough to finish one quest or complete a meal. I don't level up or play 4 cards, that 259 lasted just over 1 doctor appt! SAD

Update 4/18/22 No change. This used to be fun but now they have lowered the odds where some rooms are almost impossible to complete. Everyone is looking for the same items in the rooms. Sometimes you get 99+ of one item in Slots and none of another. Bingo rooms are too expensive with minimum payout. Been playing some rooms for over a year and can't complete. Items that are hard to get are not giftable. Support is a joke. Close tickets without reason and do not respond. I can go on and on....

Ive been playing for years. This game has turned into a money eater. You can barely win unless you make a purchase, and once they sucker you into doing that, you start getting less and less for the amount you spend. My 'plus' account does worse than accounts where I've never spent any money. They claim its luck, but what are the chances, all 7 of my accounts land on 20 credits for the daily bonus spin, nearly every time? That's not luck or chance, that's rigged.

I like to play this game, it's hard to move forward. It's a good way to pass the time. But for the past 2 days I've not been able to connect to the game at all. I've cleared my cache & even reinstalled the game & still nothing. UPDATE: so yesterday I was able to log on for a few minutes, just enough to contact support. Wasn't able to log on again. Tried to log on today, but still nothing. I tried replying to the email that support sent, it told me to log into the game & contact support..how?

Uninstalled this game because it's become nearly impossible to win without spending money. You barely get any credits to use daily. They may last you a couple of games, and then they're gone. It's just not fun anymore. Additionally, the fact that you now have to buy power-ups with gems is ridiculous! Used to be that you could buy them with coins, but now this game forces you to spend money if you're running low on the decent power ups. Honestly, the game has just become one giant cash grab.

I liked playing, but now it glitches all the time! Plus, when you run out of bingo credits and have cooked everything, there's no way to get more without paying a ton of money and even then you barely get any bingo credits to play, not even enough to play a 4 cards in the better rooms. I have played alot, now I'm out of credits, out of things to make, and no way to keep playing. I'll look into a different game now because of this. Fix the glitches and make it actually free to play unlimited!

I really enjoy this game. Couple of negatives. 1st, it takes awhile to complete rooms and earn credits to play. I stopped playing several years ago and picked it back up recently. Many things improved but not this. There are also a lot of side mini games and pop ups that I could do without. I just want to play Bingo and feel like I'm making progress. Still a good game and if you willing to pay for credits you would probably really enjoy it.

Pop ups. There is a constant barrage of pop ups after every. Single. Game. It also forces you to participate in some of its themed events, adding EVEN MORE pop ups in between games. I like the games; I can only play a handful of them at a time though, because the constant, endless, disruptive pop ups become so infuriating that you want to sert your device on fire just to make them stop and let you PLAY THE DANG GAME. I have to leave after a couple games or I'll lose my mind. I do NOT recommend.

I loved this game until recently. I got a free round for the CSI bingo which won't load, so there goes my free round, plus you only get enough credits in a day to play 1 maybe 2 rounds a day. I'm just getting very disappointed with this game. PART 2 - after response from company. Changed my star rating from 3 to 1. I was talking about losing credit/free rounds, and the company responses with, it's a game of chance. What does me losing credits/free rounds, have to do with a game of chance?

Fun but too expensive to enjoy. In order to be included in the jackpot you have to spend 900 coins ($35 real money to buy) per round for 4 cards. Only the rich can reap the benefits. Dont get me wrong, you can play cheaply, but you dont get much. The more you spend, the better the odds & rewards. Not a game for people with no money to pay to play. I love the idea of the game & storyline but can't afford to truly enjoy it. My advice, download another bingo game if you dont want to spend money.

I've spent a lot of cash the last few days... to no avail. This game should be better for free play. We should be able to receive as many gift credits as we are sent at any given time. 5 credits every 6 hours is bogus. Edit to response: no one is asking for more wins. We're asking to play MORE. After this week, aside from the $14.99 monthly fee, I've spent over $200. You CAN offer shadow cards more often during play, and can adjust the time it takes to receive our "5-6" credits we send.

I have been playing this game pretty much from the beginning. I still play it and like it. However, here is my issue. This game has "reinvented" itself a few times, and everytime it does my daily credits get lower and lower. At one point I was up to 260 a day now I am down to around 130. There are players that are lower levels than I am getting way more credits a day than me, you see the screen shots on Blitz's Facebook group. I dont think it is fair to not get the same as new players.

It was great at first! But I have some issues... 1. As you progress it is harder to earn credits. And strangely I get less bingos the further up I get. If this were really random bingo it should work out to be consistent. 2. On my Android app I can't see the numbers called board to see if I missed a number. And if I push a number that wasn't called it just lets me and doesn't tell me that it wasn't. 3. I will spend a little bit of money on a game that I love but the prices are outrageous!

I enjoy the app but with the December 10, 2019 update I can't log in, it tells me to check my connection. Another negative is the inability to complete the quests before they expire. Only way to finish them would be to buy credits and play all day, or maybe if it was a little more generous with the daily credit it gives out then I could play more than one or two games a day...personally, I will never spend cash on app games...but I do still enjoy playing

While I enjoy the simplicity and the consistent fun, I do think that the developers are out of touch with the pricing and how it relates to playing the game. I think credits to even play Bingo is ridiculous, and if you don't have any then it's almost impossible to play unless you purchase more. Adding gems for purchase to get special boosts or extras, that's fine. But all these coins are useless and can't be used to actually play bingo or purchase credits to play. The game loses appeal quickly.

I used to enjoy this game very much but it has changed drastically this year. They reduced the credits you get daily to a Max of 79 then make a room that costs over 100 credits for 1 round. They also took away the ability to trade some items. In most rooms there is at least 1 item you can't trade or gift to friends no matter how many you have. Sure its a free game but come on! ETA: playtika doesn't know their own game. My daily credits are maxed out & have been for yrs from completing the rooms.

UPDATE: GIVING YOUR PLAYERS GIFTS OF DAUB ALERT HAS HELPED TREMENDOUSLY. THANK YOU! It seems like with every update, the numbers are called faster. Or maybe with each level I increase. I can't keep up at times, and miss bingos. Wish you would slow down the caller just a bit. I wish daub alert was constant and not have to be purchased. It's difficult for me to play 4 cards and keep up. I think more people would play if it were easier to bingo.

Edit: Quit the game a couple years ago because it took forever to get enough credits to play, came back this year.. still the same. Expect it to take forever to get enough tokens to play games unless you want to beg for pieces. Not a daily game player game . 2022 Love the game! Not easy getting credits, so have to save for a few days to play long. Overall though, its a good ,fun game. 2020

I love this game. However, you just don't get enough enough creditsto be able to play. It would be nice when you level up after level 40 that you receive that leveled credits. Because after 70 it's hard to play daily because you can't ever receive enough credits. I think after 70 you receive 100 credits so you can at least 2 games. Because the wheel doesn't ever give you more than 29.. there just has to be more ways of being able to receive credits when more credits.

Clearly, I need to explain better since the answer i received has nothing to do with my review. As you advance in the game, the cards cost more. Only a certain amount of credits are awarded each day. There comes a point (unless you get a good daily credit hit on the spin), when you are only getting enough daily credits to play a single game. It's fun, but not a whole lot of game play unless you win or pay for more credits. Find a more generous bingo game.

Love it. kinda. Been playing since 2011 & I only get 106 daily credits. That's not even enough to play off of the basic level, which means that treasure chests rarely give you credits & you barely get team points, ingredients or dice, etc. I'm a plus member, & still don't get enough daily to play even 1 game at the 2nd level. Nevermind the animals running in place in mini-games. The only way I seem to get anywhere is to use actual money & buy enough credits to play at a higher level.

Rigged bloatware. The game gives new players a higher chance to hit bingos. It also costs more and more coins to buy into a round the longer you play, but rewards do not keep pace at all. Plus they word it like you'll miss out on progress items if you don't spend the same coins to get another chance, a shady gimmick to get players to spend money to play their free game. Meanwhile, the longer you play, the more popups you'll get, and the more the game starts lagging.

Unlike other games, this game comes with a low limit of "coins." Once you have used all available coins, you are required to make in-game purchases to get more in order to play or proceed through the city levels. If you are into spending your money for a hundred turns at virtual bingo with no actual reward, then this is the game for you. But, it is not worth it for me. I un-installed it after two days and reaching city-level five.

Fun to play and free if you want to take a month to get thru a level. With as much as this game makes from people making purchases, which are outrageous, you can afford to give more on the daily rewards and make it a bit easier to win. I had to change my rating from 3 to 1. It is just ridiculous how the algorithms are simply set to make money from us or we can't play. YOU ARE CHEAP! Now you can't just chat with the friends you made. You get kicked out b/c we can't play. We are BROKE!!!

Fun game! The game is listed as "free," granted it is. In-app purchases are optional. Make no mistake, I still feel it's pay to play. It has more pop-up sales, quest, and anything else for players to advance. The subscription and return are unbalanced. In the end, the game is greedy and, at times, unfair. In order to trigger quest prizes, I have to play min. mega, I have rarely seen the items included for mega. There are never 3 pics and give too many duplicates. Maximum credits NEVER!

If you are looking for a game you can play for free, look elsewhere. The game gives you an amount of in-game credits when you begin, but if you run out, they won't passively regenerate. The odds of winning a bingo become increasingly slim, and each game becomes increasingly more expensive. You are going to see other people win but sit in frustration as the numbers you need are danced around, or you just won't get any numbers at all. And again, if you run out of credits, you HAVE to purchase more

It's a fun game in the limited time in which you get to play.  Your daily credits plus whatever you *might* get in your daily free spin are good for 1.5 to 3 rounds per day.  Sometimes you can complete rooms in several days, sometimes it takes weeks.  The biggest issue is their thinly-veiled attempts to get you to spend real money on the game.  I realize that's their business but you don't get nearly enough value out of it.  Blitzy's Diner is a scam.  You get loaded up on ingredients you'll never use while premium ingredients not only rarely show up but aren't tradeable to boot.  Just poor fan service.  Elite membership isn't worth the money either.  The perks are nice I guess but not at that price point.  Either lower the cost or up the perks, I'd say.  Why not go to an ad-supported model?

Was my favorite bingo game, I have been playing it for years, just wish the items you need would come up more frequently so you'd be able to progress to new levels faster .I hate being stuck on a level for a long time. Also not enough credits given or earned to play more than a few rounds per day. Tried elite but not worth the cost. way too many pop ups to buy something, before you can even get to a game you have 5-10 pop ups. I don't think I'll be playing any longer

Chips are too expensive. Save them up and boost. Fun time passer game. So you reviewed my review and completely missed my point. I was advising other players to save their credits to play if they don't want to buy credits. I never said anything about how you win bingos, or what the odds are. Never mentioned or even indicated that if you purchase credits then you'll win. Geez.

Fun until it becomes a grind. You will reach a point where it becomes all but impossible to collect the "untradeable" cards. You will see and win the tradeable cards dozens of times just trying to collect a single 9 or 10 card, all while using all your credits. It's not fun anymore, it's annoying and frustrating. In fact, started this review with 2 stars and just reduced it to 1 because I'm annoyed just thinking about how annoying it is. "Free"...yeah, until you can't advance.

Deleted game today after years of play. They have progressively gotten more greedy. On top of it taking months to complete a room with the "ungiftables" now they just cut my daily credits in half so I can't even play one round a day. The free to play thing they boast about isn't free when you run out of credits!! I have to save for 2 days to play one round, or PAY!It's not fun, it's just frustrating. Do yourself a favor and find a different bingo game. There are literally hundreds to choose from

It is a fun game, but dang, you get 6 pop ups inbetween every single round trying to get you to purchase something. It also rips you off often when you do purchase something. I used 60 credits because it said I would get another chance at a puzzle piece. It didn't happen. I was supposed to get bonus credits for giving my email. It didn't happen. The golden spin is a rip off. I have never got anything over 75 credits. If your game freezes, you lose your credits too. They don't give them back.

I used to like this game, but now it's just a money pit. There is only enough credits to play a game or two a day unless you spend money.
